Name: WHITE_SIGN_COOL_TIME_PARAM_ST
Description: Cooldowns on summoning a new white sign after a co-op phantom leaves the host's world. The row is the running count of such departures (1–10; the 10th and later use row 10).

Fields.Name: Co-op Cooldown - Normal
Fields.Description: Seconds. When a co-op phantom leaves the host's world (for example by dying), a cooldown of this length starts; each running cooldown counts against the co-op phantoms the host can still summon. Used outside map-guardian play regions while Taunter's Tongue is not active. Retail: 180 for rows 1–4, 360 for rows 5–10.

Fields.Name: Co-op Cooldown - Normal (Taunter's Tongue)
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Co-op Cooldown - Normal, used while the host has Taunter's Tongue active. When the Taunter's Tongue state changes, running cooldowns longer than the new limit are cut down to it (never lengthened). Retail: same as Normal.

Fields.Name: Co-op Cooldown - Guardian Region
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Co-op Cooldown - Normal, used while the host is in a play region marked as a map-guardian region (PlayRegionParam) where multiplayer can start. Retail: same as Normal.

Fields.Name: Co-op Cooldown - Guardian Region (Taunter's Tongue)
Fields.Description: Seconds. As Co-op Cooldown - Guardian Region, used while the host also has Taunter's Tongue active. Retail: same as Normal.
